summary.text: Jordan Conley is the Green Party nominee. He is a personal trainer, coach, and teacher who founded the nonprofit Hapa Mana in 2016. He says he is running on universal health care, a housing-first approach to homelessness, and opposition to U.S. military engagement abroad.

paragraphs.text: Graduated from Wayne High School, according to Ballotpedia.
Says he worked as a bartender and server before spending the last 16 years as a personal trainer, coach, and teacher; he lists Burger King at age 14 as his first job.
Says he founded the nonprofit Hapa Mana in 2016 to integrate communities across income lines through sports and educational enrichment, and that COVID-19 shutdowns ended its in-person groups.
Says he had never wanted to run for office; ran unopposed in the August 8, 2026 Green Party primary (368 votes).
